{
  "task": "Convert FDA drug label text into plain language for patients (grade 5 reading level). For each drug, output: generic name, plain_purpose (one short sentence), common_side_effects (up to 4, few words each), key_warning (single most important warning in one short sentence, or null). Return JSON only with key \"drugs\" array.",
  "input": "Array of 7 drug objects with fields: generic, purpose, side_effects, warnings, boxed_warning.",
  "constraints": "Use only what the label text says. Plain language, grade 5. JSON only.",
  "approach": "Process each drug sequentially. Extract purpose from purpose field, simplify. Extract common side effects from side_effects field (most common, up to 4). Determine key_warning: choose the most important warning from warnings and boxed_warning. If boxed_warning exists and is non-empty, that's likely the most important. If not, pick from warnings. Summarize in one short sentence. If none, null.",
  "output_format": "{\"drugs\": [{\"generic\": \"...\", \"plain_purpose\": \"...\", \"common_side_effects\": [\"...\"], \"key_warning\": \"...\"}]}"
}
